You learn to blunt attacks meant for you or those nearby. When you or a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see is struck by an attack, you may use your reaction to protect it, provided you're wielding a melee weapon or a shield: roll 1d8 and add the result to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still connects, the target resists the damage dealt.

You have three uses of this feature, gaining an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and you regain all uses on finishing a long rest.
